design.observation_merge: Prefer the first observation unless it is explicitly a listing_card and another observation contains acquired JD text. Retain that entire original observation, including its own evidence and collected_at, rather than mixing an older body with newly fetched metadata. Fresh card title/deadline/question alternatives remain in observations, not promoted to top-level fields. The retained-JD warning directs readers to conflicting observations.
design.history: Flat unique snapshots retain substantive fields with original source/evidence/timestamp; aggregate history fields are excluded from snapshots. Repeated merges are idempotent; storage grows with distinct observations, not merge count. There is no silent fixed-count truncation.
design.body_selection: Text length is not an authority signal. A newly supplied detail observation wins over an older longer detail; both remain in history.
design.deadline: make_job distinguishes absent deadline from explicit null. Absent normalized deadline retains existing raw-date construction behavior. Explicit null remains unknown, with raw text and existing warnings intact throughout loading, ranking, preparation, reporting and re-saving.
